widget_mechanic: Two single-pick selector groups (Sex: Male/Female; Sterilization: Spayed/Neutered/Intact). Agent must set BOTH groups off 'Any' for a complete search; this is exactly the composition Fara skips when applying pet-adoption filters.

source_inspiration.instruction: Find a list of shorthaired dogs available for adoption within 100 miles of zip code 94587 that are good with kids and cats, and have been on the site recently.
source_inspiration.first_failure_summary: [1.4] Wrong values or constraint violation: The agent applied a subset of the criteria but left the Gender filter on 'Any' instead of composing the requested combined criteria.
